what_this_is: These six-market daily-bar base rates include asset drift: in the audited November 2016 to November 2026 sample a zero-net-mean 2,000-draw 60-calendar-day block test produced 0.98 PAID_BOTH_HALVES rows out of 54 by chance on average (95% range 0 to 3), versus 5 observed. Choosing rows on the first five years and starting flat on the last five selected 3 rows: 2 stayed positive over 362 test trades at +0.100R per trade, a retrospective dependent sample at a uniform cost of 0.05 normal day with futures roll risk and D1 path uncertainty, not a prospective probability.
